summary: Bounds-checked lookup into an array owned by the object. If the requested index a2 is negative or at/above the element count stored at offset 0x0, returns 0. Otherwise reads the dword at data[this+0x4] + 8 * a2 (8-byte element stride) and returns it.

operations.description: Guard: if index a2 < 0 or a2 >= the element count at this+0x0, the lookup is blocked and 0 is returned.
Compute the element address: data pointer at this+0x4 plus 8 * a2, where 8 is the element stride.
Return the dword stored at the computed element address (or 0 when the index is out of range).

unresolved: Only the first dword of each 8-byte element is returned; the meaning of the remaining 4 bytes of each element is unknown.
The object owner and the exact element type of the array are unknown; caller is VehicleSetupValueFormatter.
